title: SWF: non-solid stroke styles (Dashed/Dotted/Ragged/Stippled/Hatched) silently dropped
description: StrokeStyle variants Dashed, Dotted, Ragged, Stippled, and Hatched are fully modeled in packages/core/src/engine/types.ts but shapes.ts has no encoding path for them. Any shape with a non-solid stroke style is encoded as a plain solid stroke, losing the dash/dot/hatch visual entirely. Flash 8 stores these as special LINESTYLE2 FillType entries where the fill style describes the line pattern. This is a medium-complexity feature: LINESTYLE2 can carry a fill-style (instead of a color) to encode complex strokes. Fix: detect non-solid stroke types in encodeLINESTYLE2 and emit the appropriate FillType byte and fill style record.
